Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.58, 0.04, 0.38, 0.4422 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "arrow", "box": [ 0.07, 0.2936, 0.106067, 0.348 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "OFFENSE", "label_box": [ 0.062000000000000006, 0.6476, 0.122067, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "boundary", "box": [ 0.2603665, 0.2936, 0.012, 0.348 ], "color": "paper", "focus": true }, { "asset": "box", "box": [ 0.356667, 0.2936, 0.106067, 0.348 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "DEFENSE", "label_box": [ 0.348667, 0.6476, 0.122067, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** The second argument. A balance with `OFFENSE` already moving and `DEFENSE` still.

**Screen / system text — CITED, OPENAI AT BLACK HAT:**
`WE HAVE AN EXISTENCE PROOF THAT OFFENSE CAN BE FULLY AUTOMATED. WE HAVE NO SUCH PROOF FOR DEFENSE.`

`IF MODEL INTELLIGENCE IMPROVEMENTS ARE NOT MORE ADDITIVE TO DEFENSE THAN OFFENSE, EVERY INCREASE IN INTELLIGENCE FAVORS THE ATTACKER.`

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-BH` 31:32 and 36:38.

", "title": "The talk contrasts offense in motion with defense at rest" } }
